translation_notes: Twelve Namespace(...) -> twelve @prefix, named by the prefix each g.bind uses (reld, reldr, ps...), not by the Python variable (prop, res, wikidata...). `@graph g` makes g inherit them: eleven of the twelve g.bind lines disappear.

ONE g.bind is kept: the original binds `dbo` twice (ontology, then dbpedia property namespace); rdflib files the second as `dbo1`. A @prefix cannot say that (@graph adds without overwriting; a second `@prefix dbo:` in one block would shadow, not rebind), so `@prefix dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/property/> as dbpedia .` + `g.bind('dbo', dbpedia)` after `@graph g`. Declaring `dbo1:` instead would match the table but encode an rdflib accident.

The region returns an EMPTY graph whose whole content is its prefix table; two empty graphs are isomorphic, so the driver compares the namespace tables in both directions (and the expected twelve bindings) on top of run_pair; mutants killed: dbo bind dropped, a prefix IRI changed, @graph removed.
